english.title: Fail to evacuate / remain in Heathrow Airport in an emergency when instructed to do so by a constable / airport official
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, in an emergency, failed to

(A)_[evacuate]_
(B)_[remain in]_

a building, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BUILDING..) at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on Heathrow Airport when instructed to do so by

(C)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..), a constable]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..), an airport official]_
(E)_[Heathrow Airport Limited]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3.27 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
